# skycloak_cluster_events (Data Source)

Recent Keycloak admin/user events for a cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "skycloak_cluster_events" "logins" {
  cluster_id = skycloak_cluster.production.id
  category   = "user"
  realm      = skycloak_realm.app.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID.

### Optional

- `category` (String) Filter by event category (`user`, `admin`).
- `limit` (Number) Maximum entries to return.
- `realm` (String) Filter by realm name.
- `search` (String) Full-text search filter.
- `username` (String) Filter by username.

### Read-Only

- `events` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--events))

<a id="nestedatt--events"></a>
### Nested Schema for `events`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String) Event category.
- `client_id` (String) Client ID.
- `error` (String) Error code for failed events.
- `ip_address` (String) Client IP.
- `realm_name` (String) Realm name.
- `timestamp` (String) Event time (RFC 3339).
- `type` (String) Event type.
- `username` (String) Username.
